swap_risks: CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (GND vs FB), Pin 2 (SW vs EN), Pin 4 (FB vs GND), Pin 5 (EN vs SW). Soldering AP63300WU-7 onto a AP62200WU-7 footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.
CRITICAL SWITCH-VOLTAGE OVERSTRESS RISK: AP62200WU-7 is rated up to only 7 V output (p.1) vs AP63300WU-7 up to 31 V (p.5); exceeding the internal switch BVdss ceiling destroys the SW MOSFET.

HIGH SWITCHING FREQUENCY SHIFT: fsw differs by 33% (AP62200WU-7: 750 kHz p.5 vs AP63300WU-7: 500 kHz p.6); re-evaluate inductor core loss, ripple current ΔIL, output capacitor ESR ripple, and EMI harmonics.
CAUTION INDUCTOR RETUNING: Typical inductor differs (AP62200WU-7: 3.3 µH p.17 vs AP63300WU-7: 6.8 µH p.2); check inductor Isat against peak switch current limit.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RANGE SHIFT: Recommended Vin,max differs (AP62200WU-7: 18 V p.4 vs AP63300WU-7: 32 V p.5); verify line transients stay below Vin,abs,max.

CAUTION CURRENT RATING BASIS: AP62200WU-7 specifies 2000 mA (continuous Iout, p.1) vs AP63300WU-7 3000 mA (continuous Iout, p.1). Verify continuous load current and peak inductor saturation margin (Isat >= Iout + ΔIL/2).
HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: AP62200WU-7 has a lower Vin,abs,max rating (20 V, p.4) than AP63300WU-7 (35 V, p.5); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 20 V.
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 27% higher on AP63300WU-7 (AP62200WU-7: 70 °C/W p.4 vs AP63300WU-7: 89 °C/W p.5); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (AP62200WU-7: -40..125 °C Industrial / Extended (-40°C to 125°C TJ) vs AP63300WU-7: -40..85 °C Industrial (-40°C to 85°C TA, TJ max 125°C)); AP63300WU-7 hot limit only 85 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: AP62200WU-7 (Diodes Incorporated, TSOT-23-6) and AP63300WU-7 (Diodes Incorporated, TSOT-23-6) are NOT drop-in interchangeable (Level 3 PCB Layout / Circuit Change Required) due to pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (GND vs FB), Pin 2 (SW vs EN), Pin 4 (FB vs GND), Pin 5 (EN vs SW). Specific pin conflicts: Pin 1 (GND vs FB), Pin 2 (SW vs EN), Pin 4 (FB vs GND), Pin 5 (EN vs SW). Power-stage deltas: buck (sync) vs buck (sync), switching frequency 750 kHz (p.5) vs 500 kHz (p.6) (1.5x ratio), typical inductor 3.3 µH (p.17) vs 6.8 µH (p.2), feedback Vref 0.8 V (p.5) vs 0.8 V (p.6), and package θJA 70 vs 89 °C/W. Primary bench gotchas to watch: AP62200WU-7 "CRITICAL: EN Pin Abs Max Is ONLY 8.0 V — NEVER Tie Directly to 12 V / 18 V VIN!" (p.4) and AP63300WU-7 "CRITICAL PINOUT TRAP: Completely Incompatible With TI TPS54302/TPS54202/TPS563201/TPS562201 & AP62200!" (p.1). BOM decision: Choose AP62200WU-7 when matching your existing Diodes Incorporated TSOT-23-6 (TSOT26) qualification and -40..125 °C grade; choose AP63300WU-7 when bus voltage exceeds 18 V (rated to 32 V) or higher load current capacity (3000 mA) is required. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.1) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
